## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature and SuttaCentral)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and SuttaCentral data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

The *Uddesavāra* ("Specification Section" or "Indication Section") is the second textual division of the *Nettippakaraṇa* (Ne 2, PTS pp. 1–3), situated as the first subsection of the explanatory division (*vibhāga*) directly following the opening *Saṅgahavāra* [SuttaCentral; von Hinüber 1996; Caudron 2000]. Functioning as an initial outline and brief commentary on the introductory verses, it sets forth the foundational categories of the *Netti*'s exegetical method [von Hinüber 1996; Caudron 2000]. It provides the formal enumeration of the sixteen interpretive modes (*hāra*), the five guidelines or methods (*naya*), and the eighteen root-terms or constituents (*mūlapada*) [Balasooriya et al. 1980; Caudron 2000; von Hinüber 1996]. These foundational categories define the structural framework of the treatise, which receives detailed exegesis in subsequent divisions such as the *Hāravibhaṅga*, *Hārasampāta*, and *Nayasamuṭṭhāna* [Balasooriya et al. 1980].

Curated parallels recorded on SuttaCentral connect the text to another section within the work, Ne 37 (*Sāsanapaṭṭhāna*), and to the opening chapter of the related treatise *Peṭakopadesa* (Pe 1, *Ariyasaccappakāsanapaṭhamabhūmi*) [SuttaCentral]. DharmaNexus confirms substantial text reuse with Pe 1 (ten matching segments, with up to 0.77 similarity across §0.2–10.3_1), as well as reuse in other chapters of the *Peṭakopadesa* including Pe 9 (*Suttavebhaṅgiya*) and Pe 6 (*Suttatthasamuccayabhūmi*) [DharmaNexus]. Furthermore, DharmaNexus identifies significant textual overlap with commentarial works, especially the subcommentary *Nettivibhāvinī* (twenty-two matches with up to 0.93 similarity) and the *Nettippakaraṇa-aṭṭhakathā* [DharmaNexus]. No cross-language matches with Chinese, Sanskrit, or Tibetan texts are registered [DharmaNexus].

**Parallels and text reuse**

- Passage-level parallels (SuttaCentral): Ne 37 Sāsanapaṭṭhāna; Pe 1 Ariyasaccappakāsanapaṭhamabhūmi
- Text reuse within the Pali corpus (DharmaNexus): Ariyasaccappakāsanapaṭhamabhūmi (Pe 1) (§0.2–10.3_1 ↔ §10.4–22.1_0); Suttavebhaṅgiya (Pe 9) (§11.3–14.4 ↔ §54.1–57.4); Nettivibhāvinī (Tika S0501t) (§13.4–14.4 ↔ §1641_10–1643); Nettippakaraṇa-aṭṭhakathā (Atk S0519a) (§10.3_0–10.3_1 ↔ §851_2–851_4); Suttatthasamuccayabhūmi (Pe 6) (§10.3_1–11.2 ↔ §24.1–24.3); Aṅguttaranikāye Ekakanipāta-ṭīkā (Tika S0401t) (§7.1–9.4 ↔ §289–293)
